abstract: Twenty-four patients with histologically verified brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma were analyzed regarding autopsy and operative findings, signs and symptoms, diagnosis, method of treatment, and prognosis. The autopsy incidence of brain metastasis was 66.7% in patients with choriocarcinoma, and the predominance of single brain lesions was confirmed. Most of the metastatic lesions were hemorrhagic. The hemorrhages were intratumoral, peritumoral, and/or subarachnoid. These findings were well correlated with the findings on computed tomographic (CT) scans and the acute onset with rapid progression of symptoms. The history of molar pregnancy, measurements of urinary chorionic gonadotropin, and findings on CT scans were diagnostic. Surgical removal of the lesion followed by chemotherapy combined with irradiation is the treatment of choice in patients with progressive neurological deterioration in whom chemotherapy alone is ineffective.
abstract_ja: 組織学的に確認された絨毛癌の脳転移症例24例について、剖検所見と手術所見、徴候と症状、診断、治療法、予後を解析した。絨毛癌患者における脳転移の剖検での頻度は66.7%であり、単発病変が多いことが確認された。転移病変の多くは出血性であった。出血は腫瘍内、腫瘍周囲、くも膜下腔のいずれか、またはこれらの組み合わせに認められた。これらの所見は、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見および症状の急激な発現と急速な進行とよく相関していた。胞状奇胎の既往、尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の測定値、CT所見が診断に有用であった。進行性の神経学的悪化を示す患者では、化学療法のみでは効果がないため、病変の外科的切除に続けて化学療法と放射線照射を組み合わせることが治療の第一選択とされる。
